title: GAP code for the computations in the papers of E. Cosme Llópez and coauthors
description: GAP programs used for the computations in the papers of Enric Cosme Llópez and coauthors, together with the output of the runs. Each paper has its own self-contained directory under projects/: automizer-alternating, automizer-sporadic, derived-automorphisms, derived-norm and residual-defect. The code (*.g, *.sh) is released under the MIT License and the logs under CC BY 4.0; see the LICENSE files of each project.
